headline: A clean 9 of 9 AQ40 in 1h07 with no wipes and Sartura's Whirlwind halved

mvp.headline: top damage all night with 88 or better on every boss
why: Most damage in the raid, parsing 88 to 96 on all nine bosses
Soaked four of Huhuran's Poison Bolts and used 10 sappers, with no deaths

also.text: the battle rez on C'Thun, parses of 96
average parse of 90 while tanking, no deaths

overview: All 9 bosses first try in 1h07m, a few minutes under the guild's usual AQ40 (median 1h10m, best 1h02m), with only 21 deaths all night, 7 of them on trash.

Nobody had world buffs, and consumables were solid: Elixir of the Mongoose and Spirit of Zanza on 23 raiders, Mageblood on 17, 18 raiders with a flask, plus 42 mana potions, 28 Limited Invulnerability Potions and 62 sappers.

Kill times were all within a few seconds of normal. Raid DPS ran 15 to 25% under the guild's usual on Huhuran, Ouro and the Twins, while Sartura's Whirlwind, Viscidus' Poison Bolt Volley and C'Thun's Eye Beam hit fewer people than usual.

wentWell.text: Sartura's Whirlwind hit 1.95 times per raider, half the guild's usual 4.0, and she went down in 0:54 (median 1:01). Drikkle, Harrylarry and Hjärterkung parsed 94 to 96.
Skoomael's Rebirth brought Taurenlover back after a Dark Glare at 0:55, and Eye Beam hit only 12 times, 0.3 per raider against a usual 0.77.
Harrylarry (3) and Fluffycatto (2) led the kicks on Skeram: 8 of his 11 Arcane Explosions were interrupted.
No deaths on the Twin Emperors, with Barnstoker and Grilled tanking Vek'lor's Shadow Bolts (77k and 62k).

notes.text: 8 of 11 Arcane Explosions interrupted (Harrylarry 3, Fluffycatto 2, Gertggs, Wellan and Dispen one each). 1:06, right on the median.
The one death was Osinir at 0:20, killed by a mind-controlled Miniwrecker.
Three deaths in two seconds (0:22 to 0:24), all to Toxic Vapors: the poison cloud hit 14 raiders 27 times for 55k, where a usual kill has about one death to it every two kills.
Fluffycatto, Gertggs and Harrylarry kicked three of Princess Yauj's four Great Heals. The one that landed healed her for 37k.
Toxic Volley hit all 40 raiders 400 times, 10 per raider against a usual 7.5.
Whirlwind hits per raider halved compared with the guild's usual (1.95 against 4.0), so damage taken was a third lower than normal. 0:54 against a median of 1:01.
Drikkle (96), Harrylarry (95) and Hjärterkung (94) had the top parses.
0:44 against a median of 0:37, on normal raid DPS. Macharius tanked him and nobody died.
1:47 against a median of 1:56, with Poison Bolt Volley hits down to 11.9 per raider from a usual 14.1.
Snoillim died to the Toxin clouds at 1:38 after four hits. Only 3 raiders drank a nature protection potion, half the usual number.
Speldosan's Tranquilizing Shot removed her Enrage within a second, at 0:18.

She went Berserk at 30% (0:32) and died 9 seconds later, but Poison Bolt killed four people in that window (Tanknarok, Dispen, Eïnherjar and Zuzul), against fewer than one on a usual kill. Raid DPS was 83% of normal.
No deaths. Barnstoker and Grilled took Vek'lor's Shadow Bolts (77k and 62k), and only one Arcane Burst hit anyone.
3:25 against a median of 3:19 on 77% of the usual raid DPS. Blizzard hit 10 raiders 20 times, the usual amount.
Sand Blast hit 23 raiders (0.57 per raider against a usual 0.32) and, together with a Sweep, killed Makkeren at 0:26. Eïnherjar died to Ouro's melee at 1:12.
1:31 against a median of 1:34. Snotspat, Hjärterkung and Skoomael parsed 96 or higher.
Eye Beam hit only 12 times (0.3 per raider against a usual 0.77), and Skoomael battle rezzed Taurenlover after the one Dark Glare death at 0:55.
4:58 against a median of 4:45. Zuzul died to Digestive Acid in the stomach at 3:06, and Caesartje to tentacles at 4:20.
